title: Mascots on empty and one-off states: no projects, empty gallery, no filter match, job cancelled, update ready, pod connecting
description: Under umbrella MPI-846; split out of MPI-777 Phase 5 (Fabio, 2026-09-24). Landing with no projects (projectUI.js:207,228, greet PNG today) = Studio; gallery scope empty (MpiGalleryGrid.js:1979) = op's peek; filter with no match = no-results (needs the MPI-749 filter); job cancelled (generation:cancelled) = cancelled; update available (updateChecker.js:183 dialog, MpiSettings.js:53) = studio/update-ready; landing while a RunPod pod connects (heroStats.js ~209-250) = studio connecting-laptop/-screwdriver/-sparks/-spit-out cycled with transitions, then connected. no-results, update-ready, connecting x4 and connected are staged and have NEVER been shown. Rules per spot: docs/mascot-placement.md, docs/mascot-connecting.md.
